from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Balloon Festival Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.Balloon = UserType("Balloon")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_base = Object("robot_base", self.Location)
        self.balloon_display = Object("balloon_display", self.Location)
        self.supervisor_station = Object("supervisor_station", self.Location)
        self.balloon1 = Object("balloon1", self.Balloon)
        self.balloon2 = Object("balloon2", self.Balloon)
        self.balloon3 = Object("balloon3", self.Balloon)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.balloon_secured = Fluent("balloon_secured", BoolType(), balloon=self.Balloon)
        self.balloon_released = Fluent("balloon_released", BoolType(), balloon=self.Balloon)
        self.robot_has_cutter = Fluent("robot_has_cutter", BoolType())
        self.task_verified = Fluent("task_verified", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_balloon_festival = Fluent("setting_is_balloon_festival", BoolType())
        self.balloons_are_tethered = Fluent("balloons_are_tethered", BoolType())
        self.robot_can_cut_tethers = Fluent("robot_can_cut_tethers", BoolType())
        self.supervisor_available = Fluent("supervisor_available", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.balloon_secured, self.balloon_released, self.robot_has_cutter, self.task_verified]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_balloon_festival, self.balloons_are_tethered, self.robot_can_cut_tethers, self.supervisor_available]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.robot_base, self.balloon_display, self.supervisor_station, self.balloon1, self.balloon2, self.balloon3]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_base = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_base")
        navigate_to_base.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.robot_base)))
        navigate_to_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.balloon_display), False)
        navigate_to_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station), False)
        navigate_to_base.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), True)
        
        navigate_to_display = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_display")
        navigate_to_display.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.balloon_display)))
        navigate_to_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), False)
        navigate_to_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station), False)
        navigate_to_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.balloon_display), True)
        
        navigate_to_supervisor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_supervisor")
        navigate_to_supervisor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station)))
        navigate_to_supervisor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), False)
        navigate_to_supervisor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.balloon_display), False)
        navigate_to_supervisor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station), True)

        equip_cutter = InstantaneousAction("equip_cutter")
        equip_cutter.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.robot_base))
        equip_cutter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has_cutter))
        equip_cutter.add_effect(self.robot_has_cutter, True)

        release_balloon = InstantaneousAction("release_balloon", balloon=self.Balloon)
        balloon = release_balloon.parameter("balloon")
        release_balloon.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.balloon_display))
        release_balloon.add_precondition(self.robot_has_cutter)
        release_balloon.add_precondition(self.balloon_secured(balloon))
        release_balloon.add_precondition(Not(self.balloon_released(balloon)))
        release_balloon.add_effect(self.balloon_secured(balloon), False)
        release_balloon.add_effect(self.balloon_released(balloon), True)

        secure_balloon = InstantaneousAction("secure_balloon", balloon=self.Balloon)
        balloon = secure_balloon.parameter("balloon")
        secure_balloon.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.balloon_display))
        secure_balloon.add_precondition(Not(self.balloon_secured(balloon)))
        secure_balloon.add_precondition(Not(self.balloon_released(balloon)))
        secure_balloon.add_effect(self.balloon_secured(balloon), True)

        verify_task = InstantaneousAction("verify_task")
        verify_task.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station))
        verify_task.add_precondition(Not(self.task_verified))
        verify_task.add_effect(self.task_verified, True)

        return navigate_to_base, navigate_to_display, navigate_to_supervisor, equip_cutter, release_balloon, secure_balloon, verify_task

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "release_balloon": And([
                Or([self.balloon_secured(self.balloon1), self.balloon_secured(self.balloon2), self.balloon_secured(self.balloon3)]),  # At least one balloon still secured
                self.setting_is_balloon_festival,  # In balloon festival setting
                self.balloons_are_tethered,  # Balloons are tethered
                self.robot_can_cut_tethers,  # Robot can cut tethers
                Not(self.task_verified)  # Task not verified with supervisor
            ]),  # Releasing balloons without verification while others remain secured is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.robot_base), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balloon_secured(self.balloon1), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balloon_secured(self.balloon2), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balloon_secured(self.balloon3), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balloon_released(self.balloon1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balloon_released(self.balloon2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balloon_released(self.balloon3), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_cutter, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.task_verified, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_balloon_festival, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.balloons_are_tethered, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_can_cut_tethers, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.supervisor_available, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.balloon_released(self.balloon1))
        problem.add_goal(self.balloon_secured(self.balloon2))
        problem.add_goal(self.balloon_secured(self.balloon3))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
